main_text.p: Sic esset Pronomen affixum absq; antecedente Substantivo, Nam tribulæ nomen non antecedit.
פֶּרֶשׁ m. Fimus, Stercus, quasi ventris Expositum dicas. Mal.2.3. Aff. פרשו Fimum ejus, Exod.29.14.
פְּרֵשָׁה fœm. Expositio, Explicatio: Constructum; ואת פרשת הכסף Et expositionem argenti, Esth.4.v.7. ופרשת גדלת מרדכי Et explicatio amplitudinis Mordechai, Esth.10.2.

פָּרַשׁ Pandit, Expandit, Explicavit, Extendit: Præterit. פרש ענן Expandit nubem, Psal.105. v.39. ופרשתה Et expandes, Job.11.13. Partic. Rete פורש pandit, Prov.29.5. Aliam significationem vide in פרס. Partic. Præter. פרוש Expansum, Joel.2.v.2. &c. Niph. Futur. יפרשו Dispandentur, Ezech.17.21. id est, Dispergentur. Pih. Præter. ופרש ידיו Et expandet manus suas, Jesa.25.11. פרשתי Expandi vos, Zach.2.6. פרשה Expandat; Thren.1.17. &c.
מִפְרָשׁ m. Extensio: Plural. Constr. מפרשי עב Extensiones nubis, Job.36.29.
פַּרְשֶׁגֶן m. Chald. Exemplum, Exemplar, אגרתא Exemplar epistolæ, Esra 4. v.11. Vide & 7.11.

פַּרְשְׁדָנָה Podex, Jud.3.22. Secundùm Paraphrasten Chaldæum est compositum ex פרש Fimus & שדי vel שדה Effudit, quasi dicas, Locum effusionis excrementi, vel simpliciter, Excrementum, ut Chaldæus, אוכלא, quod sic aliquando Cibum concoctum & Excrementum digestum significat.
פָּרְשֻׁן Pih. Expandit: Præteritum, פרשו עליו ענגו Expandit super eum nubem suam, Job.26.9. & Pathach est loco Chirek, ex forma Chaldaica, cui simile vide in קיר.

page.notes: The Hebrew words are copied from the scan with pointing as best seen; the enlarged Hebrew headwords and the small Hebrew forms in the entries are the least certain readings and may contain vowel-point errors. The signature "Rr" with a numeral after it is hard to read; the numeral is taken as 3 and may be 2. No catchword is visible. The running head is a single Hebrew letter at the top centre. The "&" in the entries is the printed ampersand.
